qcReview.tool: scripts/data/qc_render.py <packId> <outDir> [--crop]: decodes the packed DICOM and draws every reference target on it (contour sets on the image with the largest outlined area), so a shifted, flipped or misplaced outline would show
qcReview.selectionRule: FracAtlas images with one fracture annotation, no hardware, one view, one body region, not part of a multi-scan set; one image per block of 100 image numbers (none from the round-1 blocks), the region least represented so far first.
qcReview.review: Every radiograph drawn with the fracture outline and checked by eye; the body part read on the image.
